errors.text_span: The chart contains five distinct slices, each representing one of these reasoning types.
errors.evidence: The figure shows three separate pie charts with 4, 3, and 2 slices respectively, not one chart with five slices.

errors.text_span: The “Categorical” slice is green and occupies approximately 15.12% of the total area.
errors.evidence: 15.12% corresponds to the Existential Quantifiers slice within the Categorical pie, not a whole “Categorical” slice.

errors.text_span: The “Approximate Number Generation” slice is pink and accounts for roughly 27.91%.
errors.evidence: Approximate Number Generation is a pie chart title, not a pink slice; 27.91% does not belong to that category. The pink slice in the Categorical chart is Limiter at 27.91%.

errors.text_span: The “Disjunctive Reasoning” slice is orange and represents approximately 27.91% of the total.
errors.evidence: Disjunctive Reasoning is part of the title of the rightmost pie chart, not an orange slice, and 27.91% is not its value. The orange 27.91% slice in the Categorical chart is Negation.

errors.text_span: The “Conjunctive Reasoning” slice is purple and covers approximately 49.51% of the area.
errors.evidence: Conjunctive Reasoning is part of the title of the rightmost pie chart, not a purple slice. The rightmost chart’s Conjunctive slice is light pink and is 50.49%, while 49.51% is the light blue Disjunctive slice.

errors.text_span: The “Absolute Absence” slice, colored yellow, is approximately 18.71%.
errors.evidence: Absolute Absence is light purple, not yellow, in the middle pie chart.
The description does not accurately mention that the figure consists of three separate pie charts with titles Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive.
The description incorrectly states the slices are ordered from largest to smallest; the reference says there is no specific order based on size.
